name: Marcus Vance
title: Cut my $185 Comcast bill immediately
comment: I was paying $185 every single month to Comcast Xfinity just to watch NFL games and local news. Switched to IPTVSubs8K on my Firestick with TiviMate and the quality is crystal clear 4K with zero lag. Literally saves me over $1,500 every year.

name: Sarah Jenkins
title: Setup took 3 minutes on my Samsung TV
comment: I was nervous about having to buy extra streaming sticks, but their tutorial for IBO Player on Samsung Tizen was so simple. Uploaded my playlist via MAC address and immediately had +40,000 channels. The EPG guide works great.

name: David Kowalski
title: Anti-Freeze 9.2 is real during Sunday football
comment: Most providers freeze the second a big game starts. IPTVSubs8K didn't stutter once during the entire NFL Sunday slate. Running on my Nvidia Shield with gigabit ethernet—flawless 60FPS stream.
